title: Very happy customer
text: Very happy customer. I absolutely love it, matched best on the reverse side. This is my fourth attempt to achieve the look I was going for. It’s on a twin daybed and looks fabulous!

product_metadata.title: Laura Ashley Home | Melany Collection | Luxury Premium Ultra Soft Quilt Coverlet, Comfortable & Lightweight All Season Bedding, Twin, Yellow
features: FEATURES: Reversible to a coordinating pattern allowing for two different looks. Light enough for warm weather and cozy enough for cooler nights. Pre-washed for added softness
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Machine washable for easy care. Machine wash cold, separately. Delicate cycle. Tumble dry low. Do not bleach
description: Brighten up your bedding ensemble with the Melany Quilt from Laura Ashley. Featuring a cheerful sunshine yellow ground with pink florals from the Laura Ashley archive, the design has additional charming details including a delicate ruffle edge and mini floral print reverse. Constructed with quality 100% cotton, this prewashed cotton quilt is the perfect addition to any room. Quilt is machine washable for easy and convenient care. Coordinating shams are sold separately. Twin quilt dimensions: 88 inches L x 68 inches W. Full/Queen quilt dimensions: 90 inches L x 90 inches W. King quilt dimensions: 96 inches L x 104 inches W.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low - for best results use extra large capacity commercial machine
